units: Shek. V, 1 על המ׳, v. לָבַשׁ Hif.—
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 7">Deut. R. s. 7</cite>, end <cite ref="M01477"><he>מַלְבּוּשׁוֹ</he></cite> its dress (shell), v. <cite ref="H01013"><he>חִלָּזוֹן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 113a:14">Sabb. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>שלא יהא מַלְבּוּשְׁךָ של שבת כמלבושך וכ׳</he> that thy Sabbath dress be not the same as thy weekday dress.
